title: Cephalofair Games Frosthaven Board Game
features: Epic Campaign Experience: Dive into an immersive cooperative campaign with over 130 scenarios, featuring branching storylines, character progression, and impactful decisions that shape your journey.
17 Unique Characters: Choose from a diverse roster of mercenaries, each with distinct abilities, perks, and play styles, allowing for endless strategy and replayability.
Innovative Combat System: Engage in tactical, turn-based combat with card-driven actions and unique modifier decks for each class.
Rich Storytelling: Explore a dark and immersive world where every action has consequences. Uncover secrets, forge alliances, and confront fierce enemies in the frozen tundra of Frosthaven.
Fully Compatible with Gloomhaven: You can easily integrate Frosthaven’s characters into the original Gloomhaven or Jaws of the Lion.
